verdict.rationale: Digits documents real-time profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements generated from its live ledger. Its API reference also lists on-demand endpoints to generate each statement. However, no evidence shows arbitrary-period selection, and accuracy rests only on vendor claims, so the story is not completely covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating statements for any custom date range, independent or hands-on corroboration of statement accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Digits generates real-time financial statements—profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash flow—plus live dashboards that update automatically as transactions sync
